name: ssm-quicksetup
description: Quick Setup helps you quickly configure frequently used services and features with recommended best practices.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-manager
subcommands.description: Creates a Quick Setup configuration manager resource.

subcommands.name: get-configuration
subcommands.description: Returns details about the specified configuration.

subcommands.name: get-service-settings
subcommands.description: Returns settings configured for Quick Setup in the requesting Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-configurations
subcommands.description: Returns configurations deployed by Quick Setup in the requesting Amazon Web Services account and Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-quick-setup-types
subcommands.description: Returns the available Quick Setup types.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Returns tags assigned to the resource.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns key-value pairs of metadata to Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from the specified resource.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-definition
subcommands.description: Updates a Quick Setup configuration definition.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-manager
subcommands.description: Updates a Quick Setup configuration manager.

subcommands.name: update-service-settings
subcommands.description: Updates settings configured for Quick Setup.
